original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: Exact minimum-call results for two fixed two-register endpoints in formal F2[AGL_2(F2)], where only the two coordinate shears and two coordinate translations are unit-price address labels: diag([h],[h]) and diag([h],[h_inverse]), with h(x0,x1)=(x1,x0+1).
scope_change_reason: PR1333 already proves the all-register displacement-rank floor when every rank-one affine address map costs one call. This task instead charges only four elementary affine generators and asks whether their longer direct words permit register sharing. The helper-contract suggestion overlaps the R439 helper-star lineage and PR1194/PR1306. The first identical-target search found no saving, so one bounded pivot changed the endpoint to an inverse affine pair to test inter-target cancellation.
bottleneck_link: A real saving in a paid bit-call alphabet could lower a bit-circuit profile. The selected conditional record remains complex-binding, and this abstract result supplies no physical bit supplier or kappa change.
stop_rule: Complete the exact radius-seven 3+4 join for the identical and inverse-pair endpoints, compare an independent permutation-group coefficient engine, and stop without enlarging the target/register domain.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json records the two radius-seven outcomes and canonical state hashes; verify.py and independent.py agree on both formal searches, the 6457/90859 state-ball counts, and the direct eight-call controls.
